goal: Bundle the provider execution readiness chain into one operator-facing production go/no-go evidence candidate.
risk: AOF may overclaim that the candidate authorizes production execution or proves provider safety.
loss_boundary: Do not call v9.8 complete unless the candidate names upstream evidence, missing proof boundaries, stop conditions, and release verification.
evidence_plan: release docs, capability delta, requirement coverage, work execution packet, Council review, runtime audits
stop_conditions: Stop if live provider execution is implied
Stop if production safety is claimed from structural evidence alone
